title: Your Webb County Week Ahead: A Cool Start, a Dry Thanksgiving, and a Warm, Sunny Weekend
excerpt: Your Webb County week ahead: a cool start with the coldest night Wednesday, a dry Thanksgiving Day, a warm sunny weekend, and no weather alerts.
content:
LAREDO — Here is your Webb County week ahead: a cool start with the week's coldest night Wednesday, a dry Thanksgiving Day, and a warm, sunny weekend finish.

Monday is mostly sunny, high near 68, low near 52. Tuesday turns cloudy and cooler, high near 61, low near 42. Wednesday is sunny but the coldest day, high near 65, low near 39 — the week's coldest night, so bundle up Wednesday morning.

Thursday, Thanksgiving Day, is mostly sunny, high near 67, low near 47. Friday brings morning clouds and afternoon sun, high near 66, low near 50. Saturday warms up, partly cloudy, high near 75, low near 54. Sunday is the warmest day, sunny, high near 76, low near 51.

Rain chances stay low all week — 20 percent Monday, 10 percent or less the rest of the week. Winds stay light to moderate, 5 to 12 mph, shifting from the north early in the week to the south by the weekend. No weather alerts are in effect for Webb County.

Bottom line: the coldest mornings are Tuesday and Wednesday, so layer up early in the week. Thanksgiving Day looks dry and mild, and the weekend turns warm and sunny — good weather for getting out. Stay warm out there, Webb County.
